To his right, another performer in a plaid shirt and a festive birthday hat is positioned behind a keyboard rig. A large LED screen in the background displays a cartoon character and a burger illustration. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a male host (Ethan Kuan Kuan) wearing a light grey shirt and white pleated trousers. He is speaking directly to the camera with high energy and expressive hand gestures against an outdoor event backdrop with scaffolding and city lights. (3) Two young male performers on stage interact dynamically; one in a black t-shirt and jeans stands atop a metal equipment platform, while another in a plaid shirt faces him. They are bathed in vibrant blue and purple stage lighting with a massive crowd visible in the distant background. (4) Close-up shot of a singer wearing a black and white horizontally striped shirt performing with deep emotion. His eyes are closed, and his hand is placed over his heart. The lighting is dominated by warm red and yellow hues, with city buildings blurred in the night background. (5) A wide-angle shot from behind a blonde-haired singer playing an acoustic guitar. He faces an immense, dense crowd of spectators holding up glowing smartphones at an outdoor festival. Colorful night market stalls with glowing lanterns are visible along the perimeter of the venue. (6) Three band members are grouped together on stage during a celebration. One member in a yellow t-shirt and birthday hat holds an acoustic guitar, while another in a plaid shirt presents a small birthday cake with a lit candle. All are smiling and laughing. (7) A medium close-up shot shows two members laughing and singing into a single microphone. The lighting shifts to intense pink and purple strobe effects. The performer on the left gestures playfully toward the crowd while the other laughs heartily. (8) Replay of the initial scene: Jian Ting stands on stage facing the large LED screen which now features text overlays. The keyboardist next to him remains in position, and red spotlights beam down from the stage rafters. (9) A celebratory banner reading 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY' hangs across the stage scaffolding. The three band members are grouped closely; one sings into a microphone while the other two participate in the surprise celebration, holding the cake and a guitar. (10) The lead singer, wearing a black shirt with a large '7' graphic, stands atop the metal platform. He performs with high intensity, reaching out to the audience. The stage is flooded with brilliant blue light and hazy atmospheric smoke as the crowd cheers in the foreground.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a vlog-style highlight reel of a live performance by the band 'Bestards' (理想混蛋) at the New Taipei River and Ocean Music Festival. Its primary intent is to share the emotional and joyful atmosphere of the concert, specifically highlighting a surprise birthday celebration for band member Jian Ting. It combines high-energy stage footage with intimate, behind-the-scenes-style interactions to strengthen the bond between the band and their fans.
